issue.title: Bank guide's sample bob bank import output no longer matches print_human
issue.description:
Compare the "Output" block in `docs/guides/acknowledge-bank-transactions.md` §1 ("Download and import on Monday") with what `print_human` in `src/native/bank/import_run.rs` emits (bob-cli `e7aa392d`).

The guide shows:

```text
🏦 Import · WF Checking · Nov 1 – Nov 14 · Checking1.qfx
  9 new (waiting) · 23 matched your rows · 41 already seen · 0 ambiguous · 4 before start
  out $1,204.33 · in +$2,500.00
  ledger balance $12,345.67 as of Nov 14 · ✓ balanced
  → bank/2026-11.md  +9 rows, 23 IDs
Committed bank: import 9 rows (checking).
```

`print_human` actually prints `<file> · <account> · <start>–<end>`, then `  New N · matched N · seen N · ambiguous N · before start N`, `  Out $… · In +$…`, `  Ledger balance $… on YYYY-MM-DD`, an `Accounts:` block (`  <label> · ✓ balanced · through <date>`), `Affected: <paths>`, `Committed <subject> (<sha>)`, and `Sync: pre …, post …`. It has no 🏦 header, no `→ bank/... +N rows, N IDs` line, and different count wording. Fix: regenerate the sample from a real `bob bank import` run (fixed `BOB_NOW`), or change `print_human` if the guide's richer layout was the intended design.

payload.entry: Resolved by bob-cli-no.2 commit c94a718d: the Monday guide sample was regenerated from a real fixture import per phase close note. Landing compared its file/account/date header, New/matched/seen counts, Out/In, Accounts, Affected, full commit SHA, Sync, Deleted and Next lines with current print_human; the obsolete bank emoji header and arrow row summary are gone. No separate docs change remains.
